title: Changing Of The Guards
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
Sixteen years,
Sixteen banners united over the fields
While the good shepherd grieves
Desperate men, desperate women divided,
Spreading their wings 'neath the falling leaves.
Fortune calls.
I stepped forth from the shadows, to the marketplace,
Merchants and thieves, hungry for power, my last deal gone down.
She's smelling sweet like the meadows where she was born,
On midsummer's eve, near the tower.

[intro]
The cold-blooded moon.
The captain waits above the celebration
Sending his thoughts to beloved maid
Whose ebony face is beyond communication.
The captain is down but still believing that his love will be repaid.
They shaved her head.
She was torn between Jupiter and Apollo.
messenger arrived with black nightingale.
I seen her on the stairs and I couldn't help but follow,
Follow her down past the fountain where they lifted her veil.

[intro]
I stumbled to my feet.
I rode past destruction in the ditches
With the stitches still mending 'neath heart-shaped tattoo.
Renegade priests and treacherous young witches
Were handing out the flowers that I' given to you.
The palace of mirrors
Where dog soldiers are reflected,
The endless road and the wailing of chimes,
The empty rooms where her memory is protected,
Where the angels' voices whisper to the souls of previous times.

[intro]
She wakes him up
Forty-eight hours later, the sun is breaking
Near broken chains, mountain laurel and rolling rocks.
She's begging to know what measures he now will be taking
He's pulling her down and she's clutching on to his long golden locks.
Gentlemen, he said,
I don't need your organization, I've shined your shoes,
I've moved your mountains and marked your cards

[bridge]
Or else your hearts must have the courage for the changing of the guards.

[intro]
Peace will come
With tranquility and splendor on the wheels of fire

[bridge]
And cruel death surrenders with its pale ghost retreating
